verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v1: yā dawlata nuṣibat lahā l-ʾaʿlamu gharratki sāʿata ṣubḥihā l-ʾaḥlamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v2: faradadti ṭarfaki ʿan halaki wāḍiḥi waghafalt ʿan taʿasi lahu ʾilmāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v3: falaʾanti shuʾumu liṭ-ṭabāʾiʿi kullihā shaqiyat bika l-ʾashjāru wal-ʾaqwāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v4: ʾafsadti mā banati l-ḥayātu lʾahlihā wanaqaḍti mā qad ʾathbata l-ʾaḥkāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v5: wabaqīti dawlata mustabiddi jāʾiri ṣaraʿathu fī ghulawāʾihi l-ʾāthāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v6: bakati l-jazīratu mā ʾashadda bukāʾahā wataṭaffalat fī ẓillihā l-ʾaytāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v7: faqadat majādatahā wabaʿḍa fakhārihā waʿala maʿālimahā jawā waẓalamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v8: watafarraqat ʾusrātuhā wasurātuhā watajawwalat fī tīhihā l-ʾaʿlamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v9: wabiʾithrihā l-ʿummālu dhāqū ḍarbaha ʾaqsā waʾafẓaʿu mā yadhūqu l-hāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v10: ṭuridū bʾidhniki baʿda ʾalfi khasāsati faʿarā qulūbahumu ʾasā wahuyāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v11: muniʿū ḥuqūqahumu waʾuhmila qawluhum fakaʾannahum dūna l-ḥuqūqi ṭughāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v12: waʿalayhimu l-ʾinfāqu fī ḥurumātihim waʿalayhimu fī jinsihim ʾikrāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v13: min baʿdihim ʾarsalti naḥwa tiwāwuni jundā biʾaydīhim ʾadhā waḥimāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v14: waʾamartihā biʾisāʾati limukarrami mā nālahu fī l-manhajayni malamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v15: jundā bahāʾima la yarawna lirabbihim ḥurumā wala yadrūna mā l-ʾislamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v16: faʾatā sukārā mulḥidīna kaʾannamā fīhim biqatli l-muslimīna gharāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v17: waʾamāmahum baytu l-ʾilahi waquṭbuhu fī l-khuldi bayna r-rawḍatayni yanāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v18: ʾasadu ʾidhā ʾayqaẓtumūhu lijahlikum faladayhi min kaffi l-ʾilahi ḥusāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v19: man dhā yusīʾu ʾilā l-khalīfati ʿāmidā waʾilā ḍarīḥatihi walaysa yuḍāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v20: falʾin hataktum fī tīwāwun sitrahu falaʾinna dhalika fī l-ʾilahi jusāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v21: kanafu yaḥḥuṭu bhi l-warā ʾawzārahum liyaʿʿumahum min faḍlihi l-ʾinʿāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v22: fasalū lʾaʿḍāʾi l-ḥukūmati mā raʾā min qablu fīhā wal-ʾimāmu ʾimāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v23: falakam ʾatawhā mudhʿinīna kaʾannamā fawqa r-ruʾūsi mina l-hudūʾi ḥamāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v24: yatakaffafūna linaṣrihi waduʿāʾihi kay la yukhayyaba fīhimu l-ʾaqsāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v25: falʾannahu ʾamsā ʾilā mīʿādihi naqaḍū l-withāqa wafī l-withāqi salamu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v26: lakin likulli ḥukūmati mahmā ʿtalat tuʾudhī ʿiyāla ṣ-ṣāliḥīna tamāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v27: hadhī dakāru bakat biʾaʿlā ṣawtihā tashkū washakwāhā ʿalayki ḥarāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v28: ʾankarti ʾirtha rijālihā warijāluhā bayna l-bariyyati fī l-qadīmi kirāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v29: waʾaradti nazʿa madīnati min ʾahlihā min baʿdi mā sakanū bihā waʾaqāmū
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v30: wajahilti ḥaqqa l-ʾaṣli fī ʿādātihim ghaḍibat lidhalika yūfuhā wawukāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v31: rabbī warabba l-ʿālamīna jamīʿihim ʾinnā biḥukmi l-jāʾirīna nusāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v32: ʾahlik wafarriq jamʿahum waʾamithumu fī ḍ-ḍaymi ʾidh hum sūqatu waliʾāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v33: la tanẓuranna kabīrahum waṣaghīrahum fajazāʾuhum fī yawminā l-ʾiʿdāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v34: ẓalamū waẓulmu l-mūminīna kabīratu yā man lahu fī l-muʾuminīna dhimāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v35: hadhā bijāhi muḥammadi waʾamīnihi quṭbi r-rijāli waman ʾilayhi khitāmu
verses.ya-dawlatan-nusibat-laha-l-a-lamu-c1-v36: ṣallā ʿalayhi llāhu khayra ṣalatihi mā khaṭṭa min tadhkārihi l-ʾaqlamu
